Theorem
[Mean value property using heat spheres] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0395 ↗ thm:chow-iii-riemannian-heat-mean-value-property 1. ch26:26.42\group Heat Balls

Under the hypotheses of Theorem 3, \[ u(x_0,0)=\int _{\partial E_r}u(y,t) rac{| abla H|^2}{\sqrt{| abla H|^2+|\partial _tH|^2}} \, d\widetilde\sigma (y,t). \]
Proof

\sketch Apply the space-time divergence theorem to $uH\partial _t+u abla H-H abla u$ on truncated heat balls and let the top time tend to zero.

□
